title: 第十一章 这都是送上门的羁绊啊第十二章 决裂的师徒关系下贱如野草
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:
;;
沧澜星斗虽然是小域，但大大小小的灵山宝地不少，怒云山脉就是其中一座中等灵山。
从天空里看去，这条山脉，仿佛一头趴伏着的老乌龟，乌黑而深邃，既有嶙峋高山，也有幽暗深渊，鸟鸣兽吼之声，不时响起。
大片地方，草木丛生，又格外的巨大粗长，仿佛一方原始无比的碧绿色的海洋。在这片绿海的最中央，有一片方圆百里的白色雾气包裹之地，其中景象，看不清楚，那就是——怒火道宗的山门所在。
……
这一天清晨，霞光初起，群山犹寂，放眼看去，绿叶摇瑟，一片刚刚从黑暗中舒醒的安逸美好景象。
哗啦——
下一刻，浩大无比的声音起来！
南边方向的天空里，陡然波澜大起，一把百丈长的捣药杵样的乌黑东西，翻滚着黑色玄光，高速冲来，直指守护着怒火道宗的山门大阵。
黑杵过来，势如排山倒海！
碎骨杵！
虫姥姥有名的宝贝！
到底还是这个老邪物，最先赶来了，人影还没到，法宝已经先轰了出来。
轰隆隆——
几息之后，惊天动地的轰隆之声，炸响开起，彻底打破了清晨的山野宁静，整座怒云山脉，似乎都开始剧烈颤抖起来，不过一击之下，大阵未开，反而有璀璨光影爆起，有什么被触动了一般。
山门大阵的雾气，疯狂翻滚，爆炸开的气浪，碾压向四面八方里！
炸！
炸！
炸！
山石，草木，瞬间碎为齑粉，化为滚滚尘浪飞去，大地疯狂开裂，地面上的存在，朝下哗哗掉落去，景象恐怖无比。

“赢商，你这个狗东西，给我滚出来——”
尖锐阴森的大喝声里，第二记，第三记，更多攻击，紧跟着来。
……
山门之内，自然是上下震动。
为数不多的几十个弟子，第一时间，就被惊动，随后是齐刷刷的出了自己的修炼之地来。
东元谷这里，人数最多。
这帮子外门弟子，修道天份虽然不怎么样，但脑子转的不慢，马上猜到是赢商的仇家，找上门来了，顿时惴惴不安起来，也不知道山门大阵，顶不顶的住。
一抬眼，就见浪三刀踏着一道金光，直冲山门方向去，这帮小子交换了一下眼色，也咬牙跟了上去。
冰云峰那边。
即便身在阵法中，剑横秋七人，也第一时间，感觉到了巨大的震动，个个立刻警醒。
可惜！
这一帮狡诈逆徒，被关在这大阵里，身上又被赢商种下了独门手段，根本不敢有异动，只能默默怨毒。
剑横秋也目光阴沉复杂，心思难知。
……
再说浪三刀赶到山门出口处的大广场时，赢商这个老家伙，赫然已经先到了。
老家伙一身束腰的白袍，身材修长挺拔，恢复成少年时的俊秀样子之后，更有股子非凡气质，一头乌黑长发，洋洋洒洒的朝后飘飞着，嘴角挂着一个若有若无，似笑非笑的笑意。神秘潇洒，又自信从容。
好气质！
好风采！

Although Canglan Xingdou is a small domain, it has many treasures of spiritual mountains, large and small, and Nuyun Mountain Range is one of the medium-sized spiritual mountains.
Seen from the sky, this mountain range looks like a lying old turtle, black and deep, with rugged mountains and dark abyss, and the sounds of birdsong and beasts roaring from time to time.
A large area is overgrown with vegetation, and it is extremely large, thick and long, like a primitive turquoise ocean. In the very center of this green sea, there is a land wrapped in white mist with a radius of a hundred miles. The scene in it cannot be seen clearly, that is - the mountain gate of Wrath Dao Sect.
…
In the early morning of this day, the twilight was beginning to rise, and the mountains were still silent. Looking around, the green leaves were swaying, and it was a peaceful and beautiful scene that had just woken up from the darkness.
Wow——
The next moment, a huge voice sounded!
In the sky to the south, waves suddenly rose, and a black thing like a medicine pestle that was a hundred feet long, rolling with black light, rushed at high speed, pointing directly at the mountain gate formation guarding the Wrath Dao Sect.
The black pestle came over, and it was like an overwhelming force!
Bone-crushing pestle!
Grandma Chong’s famous baby!
After all, it was this old evil creature who came first. Before the figure arrived, the magic weapon had already been blasted out.
Rumble——
A few breaths later, an earth-shattering rumbling sound exploded, completely breaking the tranquility of the early morning mountains. The entire Nuyun Mountains seemed to begin to tremble violently. However, with one blow, the formation did not open, but bright lights and shadows exploded, as if something had been touched.
The fog in the mountain gate formation rolled crazily, and the explosive air waves crushed in all directions!
fry!
fry!
fry!
The rocks, vegetation, and trees instantly shattered into powder and turned into billowing waves of dust that flew away. The earth cracked crazily, and the existence on the ground fell downwards. The scene was extremely terrifying.
"Ying Shang, you piece of shit, get out of here—"
Amidst the sharp and sinister shouts, the second, third, and more attacks followed.
…
Inside the mountain gate, it was naturally shaking up and down.
The few dozen disciples were immediately alarmed, and then they all rushed out of their training ground.
Dong Yuan Valley has the largest number of people here.
Although these outer sect disciples were not very talented in cultivating the Taoism, they were quick to guess that they were Ying Shang's enemies and had come to visit them. They suddenly became anxious and uneasy, not knowing that the mountain gate formation would not be able to withstand it.
As soon as he raised his eyes, he saw Lang San Dao heading towards the mountain gate with a golden light. The boys exchanged glances and gritted their teeth and followed.
Over there at Bingyun Peak.
Even though they were in the formation, Jian Hengqiu and the other seven people immediately felt the huge vibration, and all of them were immediately alert.
pity!
This group of cunning traitors were imprisoned in this large formation, and Ying Shang planted their own unique methods on them. They did not dare to make any changes at all, and could only silently resent them.
Jian Hengqiu's eyes were dark and complicated, and his thoughts were difficult to understand.
…
Besides, when Lang Sandao rushed to the big square at the entrance of the mountain gate, the old guy Ying Shang had already arrived first.
The old guy was wearing a white robe with a waistband, and his figure was slender and straight. After returning to the handsome appearance of his youth, he had an extraordinary temperament. His long black hair was flying backwards, and there was a faint smile hanging on the corner of his mouth. Mysterious and chic, yet confident and calm.
Good temperament!
What a style!
